evals.name: kyoto-reservations-first
evals.prompt: can you make us a nice itinerary website for kyoto? me and my partner, mar 12-16 2027, staying at Ace Hotel Kyoto. we land at KIX 2:30pm on the 12th, fly out of KIX 6pm on the 16th. top priority is dinner at Kikunoi Honten on the 14th (books 1 month ahead i think). also want fushimi inari early morning, nishiki market, weekenders coffee, arashiyama bamboo, and some good matcha. want maps for each day and to see prices in USD. make it look clean and minimal, japandi vibe
evals.expected_output: Single HTML page: per-day maps with numbered stops matching timeline, Kikunoi as priority with booking-release guidance, area grouping, JPY with USD, Weekenders hours respected.

evals.name: paris-bakeries-wine
evals.prompt: turn our paris trip into a shareable page w maps. may 3-8 2027, hotel is Hôtel National des Arts et Métiers in the marais. bookings: septime dinner may 5 (this is THE one, opens 3 weeks ahead), louvre timed entry may 4 morning, and we want du pain et des idées, a natural wine bar or two, the marché des enfants rouges, and a day in montmartre. we land CDG 8am may 3, leave CDG 1pm may 8. group stuff by neighborhood so we know whats near what. euros + usd pls
evals.expected_output: Page with neighbourhood grouping, Septime priority w/ release date, EUR+USD, Du Pain et des Idées closed days respected (weekends), maps per day.

evals.name: seoul-pasted-planner
evals.prompt: (Seoul planner with confirmation code QX82LM, Mingles booked Sun Oct 3 7pm, Jungsik waitlist, wish list) make it into an itinerary website we can both use on our phones, booking tracker we need to tick off
evals.expected_output: Page from pasted planner; confirmation code NOT on page; Mingles flagged for Sunday closure; tick-able tracker; KRW+USD; maps per day; area grouping.

evals.name: taipei-allergy-cards-badges
evals.prompt: can you make a trip page for my sister and her husband, they're in taipei apr 8-12 2027 at the Mandarin Oriental Taipei. he's allergic to shrimp and lobster but crab and squid are totally fine, and fish sauce is ok. she doesn't eat beef. here's my list: din tai fung xinyi (been, love it), raohe night market (been), fuhang soy milk (never been, on my list), yongkang beef noodle (friend swears by it), elephant mountain at sunset, and this place my friend sent https://www.instagram.com/some_cafe_tpe. they don't read chinese
evals.expected_output: Page with a Traditional Chinese food card listing what he can't eat (shrimp, lobster) AND what he can (crab, squid, fish sauce), her no-beef line, and a hotel card with the hotel's Chinese name and address. Badges match the user's words (favourite/been, on my list, friend's pick). The Instagram link is not used as a place's map link. No unrequested diet advice.
